description: This file contains a shell script used for testing the integration of Git with Subversion (svn) using the 'useSvmProps' feature. It loads SVN repository data, initializes Git-SVN mappings, configures settings, verifies commit metadata, and performs some svn-related commands within a test framework.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified description.

methods.name: git admin load
methods.description: Loads SVN dump data into a repository.

methods.name: git svn init
methods.description: Initializes a new Git-SVN mapping with specified URLs and revision ranges.

methods.name: git config svn.useSvmProps
methods.description: Configures the Git SVN integration to use SVM properties.

methods.name: git svn fetch
methods.description: Fetches data from the SVN repository.

methods.name: git cat-file commit
methods.description: Outputs commit object data for specified refs.

methods.name: git svn find-rev
methods.description: Finds the Git revision corresponding to an SVN revision.

methods.name: git svn rebase
methods.description: Rebases the current branch with latest SVN commits.
